summary: The two predecessor facts apply under the stated hypotheses. Substituting m=q(1+R) into the strict scalar bridge gives D<tau(R), while the cap bound gives D>=delta, yielding the first contradiction including equality. On the closed rational box, the predecessor gives D>=2/5 and the elementary estimate tau(R)<49/225<2/5 yields the second contradiction. The cited predecessor statements also cover the claimed coincident-endpoint and ratio-boundary cases, and the remaining zero-area cutting-line conventions do not alter either area inequality.
